_doc: OpenBuilds' Mini V Wheel in Delrin (part 165): a smaller wheel for V-Slot's track, on two MR105 bearings, with the mini eccentric spacer that sets its preload. Its rim and bearing seats are read off OpenBuilds' drawing; the plastic's figures are Delrin 150's, the grade not being named. OpenBuilds shares its designs under CC BY-SA 4.0: dimensions are taken, the shape is drawn by the kit from them.
name: v-wheel-mini

wheel_diameter.rule: Outside diameter, at the flat of the rim: 15.23 on the drawing
wheel_diameter.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "Mini V Wheel (parts 165 and 874)", as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings

wheel_seat_depth.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "Mini V Wheel (parts 165 and 874)", as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings

wheel_angle.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "Mini V Wheel (parts 165 and 874)", as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings

wheel_bearing.rule: It runs on two mr105 bearings pressed into its seats, one from each face
wheel_bearing.source: OpenBuilds Part Store, "Xtreme Mini V Wheel Kit": bearings 105zz, 5 x 10 x 4 mm, as a web search read the page https://us.openbuilds.com/xtreme-mini-v-wheel-kit on 2026-11-17 (the page itself did not load here)

wheel_bearings.rule: Two bearings, side by side with the lip between them
wheel_bearings.source: OpenBuilds Part Store, "Xtreme Mini V Wheel Kit": bearings 105zz, 5 x 10 x 4 mm, as a web search read the page https://us.openbuilds.com/xtreme-mini-v-wheel-kit on 2026-11-17 (the page itself did not load here)

wheel_lip.rule: The lip between the two bearing seats, 1.0 mm wide as drawn
wheel_lip.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "Mini V Wheel (parts 165 and 874)", as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings

wheel_material.rule: Moulded in Delrin (acetal homopolymer, black); a polycarbonate wheel of the same drawing is sold as Xtreme and is not this set
wheel_material.source: Electrokit, "Solid V Wheel Kit" (an OpenBuilds kit, page marked outdated): the kit holds 1 Solid V Wheel, 2 ball bearings 625 2RS, 2 5 mm precision shims and a lock nut with nylon insert; "Material - Delrin (black)", https://www.electrokit.com/en/solid-v-wheel-kit

wheel_modulus.rule: The tensile modulus of Delrin 150, for the wheel's contact on its track: OpenBuilds does not name the grade, so this is the common extrusion grade's
wheel_modulus.source: Trident Plastics, technical data sheet "Delrin 150 NC010": tensile modulus 3100 MPa (ISO 527-2), https://plastics.tridentplastics.com/Asset/TDS_Delrin150%20NC010.pdf, as a web search read it

wheel_poisson.rule: Poisson's ratio of acetal: a usual figure for it, not read from a data sheet here
wheel_poisson.source: A working figure of @rulecad/frames: no data sheet read gives it

wheel_contact_stress.rule: The contact pressure the rim is held to: Delrin's compressive stress at 1% deformation, so the rim does not take a flat. Taken as the Hertz peak pressure of the rim on the track
wheel_contact_stress.source: HPC Europe, Delrin data sheet: compressive stress 36 N/mm2 at 1% deformation (ASTM D695), https://www.hpceurope.com/docFichesTechniques/DelrinPlastic.pdf, as a web search read it

wheel_thread.rule: It turns on an M5 screw through its bearings' 5 mm bores
wheel_thread.source: OpenBuilds Part Store, "Xtreme Mini V Wheel Kit": bearings 105zz, 5 x 10 x 4 mm, as a web search read the page https://us.openbuilds.com/xtreme-mini-v-wheel-kit on 2026-11-17 (the page itself did not load here)

wheel_eccentric.rule: The eccentric spacer made for it, under the wheels on one side of a plate to set their preload
wheel_eccentric.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "Mini V Wheel (parts 165 and 874)", as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings
